field.name: weight
field.description: Divides damage launch strength through 200 / max(0.01, weight + 100); larger weight reduces launch speed.

field.name: movement
field.description: Movement tuning used by the Shared simulation; see the movement field descriptions.

field.name: presentation
field.description: Semantic animation roles and model placement; these values do not bind asset files.

field.name: capsuleRadius
field.description: Movement capsule radius; larger values widen world collision and fighter separation.

field.name: capsuleHeight
field.description: Full movement capsule height; larger values make the collision body taller.

field.name: hipHeight
field.description: Hip pivot height above the capsule bottom; also positions baked geometry when no baked hips-offset point exists.

field.name: hurtboxRadius
field.description: Fallback sphere radius when no capsule geometry is available; larger values make the fallback easier to hit.

field.name: shieldRadius
field.description: Shield sphere radius; larger values protect a wider area and must exceed half the capsule height.

field.name: captureGeometry
field.description: Universal grab reach and holding anchors; command grabs have their own capture hitbox.

field.name: hurtboxCapsules
field.description: Fallback vulnerable capsules relative to the capsule center, rotated with facing; baked bone geometry replaces them when available.

field.name: hurtboxBoneDefs
field.description: Vulnerable capsules built from sampled bone points; the asset cook must provide those points.

field.name: attachmentBoneIds
field.description: Additional underscore-prefixed attachment point names that a pose bake may supply.

field.name: presentationIds
field.description: Semantic effect or sound cues this package declares; declaring an ID does not supply its asset.

field.name: capabilityRequirements
field.description: Versioned public engine features used by the kit; each used capability must be declared.

field.name: slots
field.description: Explicit move definitions; aliases must resolve every canonical ground and air entry.

field.name: aliases
field.description: Source-only move reuse; cooking expands each alias to a complete runtime move.

field.name: shell
field.description: Shell landing splash and wave ride settings; requires the shell-stance capability and shell animation role.

field.name: alternateForm
field.description: Second form movement, animation roles and move grid; uses the top-level body and requires forms capability.

field.name: runSpeed
field.description: Ordinary ground speed cap; larger values run faster and scale the shared start and braking ramp.

field.name: runAccelerationA
field.description: Serialized legacy ground acceleration coefficients; current ground locomotion ignores both and uses the shared speed ramp.

field.name: runAccelerationB
field.description: Serialized legacy ground acceleration coefficients; current ground locomotion ignores both and uses the shared speed ramp.

field.name: dashSpeed
field.description: Legacy dash tuning retained in source; universal air dodge uses airDodgeSpeed instead.

field.name: airDodgeSpeed
field.description: Air-dodge base speed; larger values increase its initial 2.3-times burst and subsequent eased travel.

field.name: airSpeedMax
field.description: Ordinary air steering target speed; larger values allow faster horizontal drift.

field.name: airAccelStick
field.description: Added together for ordinary air steering acceleration; larger values approach the air speed target faster.

field.name: airAccelBase
field.description: Added together for ordinary air steering acceleration; larger values approach the air speed target faster.

field.name: jumpForce
field.description: Full-jump initial vertical speed, not a force or impulse; larger values jump higher under the same gravity.

field.name: shortHopForce
field.description: Short-hop initial vertical speed; larger values make the released-jump hop higher.

field.name: airJumpVMultiplier
field.description: Multiplies jumpForce for an air jump; larger values make air jumps rise faster.

field.name: airJumpHMultiplier
field.description: Multiplies airSpeedMax for the directional velocity added by an air jump; larger values add more horizontal speed.

field.name: gravity
field.description: Downward acceleration; larger values bend flight or falling downward faster.

field.name: airFloatGravity
field.description: Gravity while below floatWindowTicks; zero means no gravity in that window, not a disabled setting.

field.name: dashDurationTicks
field.description: Retained legacy dash field; does not tune the universal air-dodge duration or cooldown.

field.name: dashCooldownTicks
field.description: Retained legacy dash field; does not tune the universal air-dodge duration or cooldown.

field.name: groundFriction
field.description: Braking toward run speed when coasting above it and in selected locked states; larger values remove that excess speed faster.

field.name: airFriction
field.description: Ordinary air drag without stick input and in fixed airborne aim; larger values slow horizontal drift faster.

field.name: maxFallSpeed
field.description: Ordinary downward speed cap; larger values allow a faster fall.

field.name: fastFallSpeed
field.description: Downward speed assigned during fast fall; larger values make fast fall faster.

field.name: maxJumps
field.description: Total jumps including the grounded jump; larger values allow more air jumps before landing.

field.name: jumpSquatTicks
field.description: Ground jump preparation before launch; larger values delay takeoff.

field.name: floatWindowTicks
field.description: Age threshold for low gravity after an explicit air-clock reset; larger values lengthen that window. Ordinary jumps and walking off a ledge skip it.

field.name: rushTicks
field.description: Serialized legacy field ignored by current ground locomotion; changing it has no movement effect.

field.name: aimMode
field.description: Selects aiming input; none disables aim, groundCursor selects a point, groundVector a horizontal direction, cameraForward3D a 3D direction.

field.name: cooldownTicks
field.description: Reuse delay applied when the activation ends or is cancelled; larger values delay the shared ground/air input slot longer.

field.name: isRecoveryMove
field.description: Resets the air float clock when the move starts; does not itself grant jumps, dodges, or a once-per-airtime availability gate.

field.name: preserveMomentumOnStart
field.description: Keeps grounded incoming horizontal velocity at ordinary startup; false clears grounded horizontal speed unless slide/run carry applies. Air momentum and capability overrides still follow their own rules.

field.name: timeline
field.description: Ordered stages of this move; each stage has its own zero-based operation clock.

field.name: chargePool
field.description: Optional shared input-slot stock and passive refill; larger stock permits more uses before waiting.

field.name: aimMovement
field.description: fixed locks grounded movement during aim; mobile admits stick movement and reserves the right stick for aiming.

field.name: aimAnimationId
field.description: Optional animation while aiming; omit to use the move animation.

field.name: allowSlideCarry
field.description: Allows an eligible grounded normal to carry a slide; incompatible with move-owned motion and aiming.

field.name: hitPresentationId
field.description: Cue emitted for a confirmed contact; a hitbox-specific value identifies a sweetspot and overrides the slot cue.

field.name: aimMovementSpeedScale
field.description: Fraction of run and air speed while mobile aiming; larger values let the fighter move faster during the hold.

field.name: shellPolicy
field.description: popOut exits the shell, tuck keeps a tucked move, ride starts the shell ride after successful completion.

field.name: maxCharges
field.description: Number of stored uses; larger values allow more activations before refill is needed.

field.name: regenTicks
field.description: Time between stock refills; larger values refill more slowly.

field.name: from
field.description: Alias entry being supplied; use a canonical slot ID.

field.name: to
field.description: Explicit move or alias reused by from; alias cycles and unresolved targets are rejected.

field.name: stages
field.description: Successive fixed parts of the move; each stage resets the operation clock.

field.name: durationTicks
field.description: Length of this stage, volume or timed effect; larger values keep it alive longer in its owning clock.

field.name: iasaTicks
field.description: Earliest early-cancel boundary; zero disables early cancellation, larger nonzero values delay cancellation.

field.name: landingLagTicks

field.name: releasePresentationId
field.description: Declared cue for the named lifecycle event; empty text disables optional cues.

field.name: level
field.description: Keeps the command-grab lunge level with gravity off; a wall that blocks the approach can end the grab empty.

field.name: anchorDistance
field.description: Hold point ahead of the owner feet; larger values keep the victim farther forward.

field.name: releaseLockTicks
field.description: Victim lock after a no-launch command-grab release; larger values keep the victim unable to act longer.

field.name: whiffRecoveryTicks
field.description: Alternate command-grab miss recovery; zero keeps the enclosing stage recovery, larger values extend a nonzero miss ending.

field.name: damage
field.description: Damage added on contact; larger values raise the victim percent and the damage contribution to launch strength.

field.name: angle
field.description: Vertical launch pitch; larger positive values launch more upward, negative values launch downward.

field.name: baseKnockback
field.description: Flat term in launch magnitude; larger values strengthen a launch at every victim percent.

field.name: knockbackGrowth
field.description: Term multiplied by 1 + victimPercent / 100; larger values make high-percent victims fly faster.

field.name: stunTicks
field.description: Zero disables ordinary hitstun; any positive value enables formula-derived stun and is not the stun duration.

field.name: takeoffTick
field.description: Cannonball launch time within the move; larger values delay takeoff.

field.name: maxRange
field.description: Maximum target distance; larger values allow the lifecycle to reach farther targets.

field.name: noTargetDistance
field.description: Forward fallback distance when there is no eligible target; larger values place the move farther ahead.

field.name: minFlightTicks
field.description: Cannonball flight time for a destination at the owner feet; larger values slow short hops.

field.name: maxFlightTicks
field.description: Projectile or flight lifetime limit; larger values allow more time before the lifecycle times out.

field.name: maxLaunchSpeed
field.description: Cannonball solved-launch speed cap; larger values allow a faster ballistic launch.

field.name: launchPresentationId
field.description: Declared cue for the named lifecycle event; empty text disables optional cues.

Enables alternateForm and swapForm; not a startCapability operation.
